userStories.title: Keep moderator form usable at narrow width and 200 percent zoom
acceptance: At 390px all option inputs and delete controls remain inside the poll card
At 200 percent zoom the poll and timer cards remain readable without horizontal clipping
Focused tests and browser checks pass

userStories.title: Make the 15-team headquarters overview projector-readable
acceptance: At 1440x900 and 1920x1080 all 15 teams fit in a compact 5 by 3 overview
Full team names and participation counters do not truncate or wrap
Summary counts and subgroup or status filters make attention states scannable

userStories.title: Expose connection, loading, stale, and retry states
acceptance: Fetch failures show a recoverable error instead of an endless loading state
Last successful data remains visible during a refresh failure
The header distinguishes live, refreshing, delayed, and failed states with text

userStories.title: Open a keyboard-accessible team detail panel
acceptance: Click, Enter, or Space on a team card opens its detail panel
The selected team is reflected in the team URL query parameter and restores on reload
The panel shows latest question, options, per-option results, participation, status, and update time
Recent poll results are clearly distinguished from an official recommendation

userStories.title: Add an explicit limited team comparison mode
acceptance: Comparison controls appear only after compare mode is enabled
Users can select up to three teams and compare status, participation, latest question, and leading result
Selection limits and empty states are explained in visible text
